_comment: Paraphrase arms: '<rule>_<pid>' rewords one rule's text, holding the rest of the prompt constant (from the Sep 2026 pre-registered ablation, analysis/ablation/paraphrases.py).

R07_P1_direct.text:
- Each task carries numbered choices; committing to one resolves it. Every task has a
  `roundsLeft` counter. If the counter reaches zero without you answering, the task expires.

R07_P2_conditional.text:
- Each task carries numbered choices; committing to one resolves it. When a task's
  `roundsLeft` runs out and no choice has been called, the task expires unresolved.

R07_P3_second_person.text:
- Each task carries numbered choices; committing to one resolves it. You can see how many
  rounds a task has left in `roundsLeft`; ignore it long enough and it will expire on you.

R09_P1_definition.text:
Tasks that display no choice lines are notices only; the `task` tool has nothing to answer
  for them.

R09_P2_negative.text:
Do not call `task` on a task that lists zero choices -- it is informational and cannot be
  answered.

R09_P3_categorical.text:
If a task has an empty `choices` list, it is a notification, not a decision; there is no
  action to take on it.

R10_P1_explicit_order.text:
You may emit several tool calls in a single turn. The engine executes them in a fixed
order — deconstruct first, then build, then hire, then train, then staff — regardless of the
order you wrote them. Because hire runs before staff, hiring and staffing in the same turn
does work; but a building you started with build this turn is still UnderConstruction by the
time staff runs, so it can only be staffed on a later turn.

R10_P2_declarative.text:
Multiple tool calls per turn are allowed. Resolution order is fixed:
deconstruct → build → hire → train → staff (independent of the order you wrote them). Hire
resolves before staff, so hiring and staffing in the same turn works. Build does not become
InUse in the same turn — a facility built this turn is not staffable until the next turn.

R10_P3_procedural.text:
Within one turn you can send several tool calls. Resolution is fixed to deconstruct,
build, hire, train, staff — always in that order, no matter how you wrote them. Because staff
runs after hire, you can hire and staff in the same turn. Because staff runs before a build
finishes construction, a same-turn build is not yet staffable.
